name: Mattress Finder
short_description: Find mattresses by sleep position, cooling, firmness, partner needs, trial, and budget.
long_description: Mattress Finder ranks physical mattresses by shopper fit across sleep position, firmness, cooling, motion isolation, mattress size, trial length, warranty, and budget. Results explain tradeoffs and include affiliate disclosure before outbound shopping links. The app provides shopping guidance only and does not diagnose or treat medical conditions.
example_prompts: Find a queen mattress for a hot side sleeper under $1,500.
Compare mattresses for couples with motion isolation.
Find a firm king mattress with a long trial.
Find a cooling mattress for a combination sleeper.
Compare hybrid and memory foam mattresses under $1,200.
affiliate_disclosure: Mattress Finder may earn a commission when users buy through partner links. Recommendations rank user fit first.
review_notes: Published deployment exposes only recommend_mattress. Affiliate links remain disabled until each merchant program is approved.
